steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize the Android project structures, establishing base folders and metadata profiles for Sound Memory Champion.

steps.title: Configure Build System
steps.description: Create the Gradle build script for the application, defining SDK target versions and setting compilation options to Java 8.

steps.title: Declare Manifest Properties
steps.description: Establish the application configuration, permissions, launcher intent, and force portrait orientation in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Visual Layout
steps.description: Develop the user interface layout XML with high-contrast UI panels, state monitors, sound pads, and control buttons.

steps.title: Implement Synth Engine
steps.description: Incorporate low-latency dynamic sine wave synthesis logic inside MainActivity using native AudioTrack API for pitch playbacks.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic UI Styles
steps.description: Develop helper methods in MainActivity to style active and inactive buttons using programmatic GradientDrawable components.

steps.title: Implement High Score Persistency
steps.description: Integrate Android SharedPreferences storage to persist and reload player scores between subsequent gaming sessions.

steps.title: Setup Game Mode Manager
steps.description: Incorporate control structures to support switching between Simon Says Memory, Pitch Trainer, and Free Play modes.

steps.title: Implement Simon Sequence logic
steps.description: Establish randomized numerical pattern generators that dynamically scale pattern lengths as players level up.

steps.title: Incorporate Animated Sound Sequences
steps.description: Write synchronized UI delay engines to sequence playback events so sound cues and light cues play in complete synchronization.

steps.title: Add Pitch Game Logic
steps.description: Establish testing algorithms for Ear Training mode that output an target tone and wait for correct musical pad recognition.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Pad Listeners
steps.description: Connect UI pad listeners to validation code, triggering success sounds and sequence progresses, or terminating on user mistakes.

steps.title: Integrate Free Play Features
steps.description: Create piano-like free-form synthesizer configurations inside MainActivity, allowing immediate low-latency play of dynamic pitches.

steps.title: Implement Tone Resource Safety
steps.description: Incorporate strict background processing and audio releasing protocols to safely dispose of AudioTrack resource instances.

steps.title: Conduct Interactive Interface Audits
steps.description: Test game responses, pad triggers, status alerts, score increases, high score records, and user interfaces validation.

steps.title: Building Sound Memory Champion
steps.description: Initiate automated system compilation of the final, ready-to-run debug APK with integrated sound game modules.
